description: The COPY INTO <table> load-option surface over an empty internal stage (live-measured cell by cell): every documented ON_ERROR spelling and VALIDATION_MODE mode compiles; bad option values refuse in one of three renderings (quoted string keeps quotes, bareword and negative integer echo bare); unknown option is invalid parameter; repeated options and the ENFORCE_LENGTH/TRUNCATECOLUMNS pair at one polarity conflict (message on the prefix line with trailing newline); MATCH_BY_COLUMN_NAME over headerless CSV and VALIDATION_MODE over a transform refuse with single-line sentences; a FILES entry the stage does not hold aborts naming the location exactly as written. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CopyOptionSurfaceTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE copt_st
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE copt_t (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR)
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = CONTINUE
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = 'SKIP_FILE'
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = SKIP_FILE_3
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = 'SKIP_FILE_3%'
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = ABORT_STATEMENT
CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE copt_st
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE copt_t (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR)
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ENFORCE_LENGTH = FALSE TRUNCATECOLUMNS = TRUE
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st LOAD_UNCERTAIN_FILES = TRUE
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st RETURN_FAILED_ONLY = TRUE
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st SIZE_LIMIT = 0
CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE copt_st
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE copt_t (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR)
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st VALIDATION_MODE = RETURN_2_ROWS
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st VALIDATION_MODE = RETURN_ALL_ERRORS
CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE copt_st
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE copt_t (a INTEGER, b VARCHAR)
COPY INTO copt_t FROM @copt_st ON_ERROR = 'BOGUS'

error.messageContains:
SQL compilation error:
invalid value ['BOGUS'] for parameter 'ON_ERROR'
